name: Chie
source: Chie has 3 different appearances (hairstyle, accessories, hair color, face expressions) and 3 personalities (interests, personality traits, speech style) based on the 13 choices made at the start of each playthrough, resulting in 9 available variations.
translation: Chie has 3 different appearances (hairstyle, accessories, hair color, face expressions) and 3 personalities (interests, personality traits, speech style) based on the 13 choices made at the start of each playthrough, resulting in 9 available variations.
